draft.title: Pluto square Chiron
draft.humanMoment: A theater revival stalls when performers learn its central scene recreates an assault the company removed from its founding history.
draft.developmentDetail: Rehearsals keep breaking down at that scene as archived notes and former members’ accounts contradict the official story.
draft.planetaryDynamic: Pluto excavates the suppressed record, while Chiron marks the original injury the company built around without acknowledging.
draft.aspectMechanic: The Pluto-Chiron square turns each attempt to resume rehearsals into the same practical conflict over whether the company will preserve the scene or confront the founding harm it repeats.
draft.conditionalConsequence: If producers keep treating the stoppages as a current cast problem, delays and departures may intensify in proportion to how long the original account was suppressed.

judge.weakest: The Pluto-Chiron square turns each attempt to resume rehearsals into the same practical conflict over whether the company will preserve the scene or confront the founding harm it repeats.
judge.why: This is the densest sentence, but it clearly applies the square’s recurring practical conflict to a specific, observable choice and remains natural enough for owner review.
